concepts.statement_en: Identify local safety requirements, hazards and reporting contacts before a BHW task.
concepts.source: presentation slides 69, 72; facilitator-guide PDF 30 outcomes a–c

concepts.statement_en: Prepare the work area, approved supplies and protective equipment for the assigned task.
Prevent needlestick injuries by using the proper sharps container and keeping sharps out of ordinary waste.
concepts.source: presentation slides 70–73; facilitator-guide PDF 30 demonstration a; reference-manual PDF 21–22

concepts.statement_en: Immediately report needlestick injury and obtain professional evaluation after appropriate first aid.
concepts.source: presentation slides 70–73; CDC Occupational Exposure to Blood recommendations

concepts.statement_en: Reduce prolonged standing, walking and awkward posture; use appropriate footwear, seating and movement breaks.
concepts.source: presentation slide 73; facilitator-guide PDF 30 demonstration c

concepts.statement_en: Plan for falls, dog encounters, physical threats and other field hazards, and report incidents promptly.
Plan shaded rest, drinking water and a safer schedule for work in hot conditions.
Recognize excessive workload and agree on boundaries and support consistent with BHW volunteer duties.
Use hand hygiene, ventilation, task-appropriate PPE and safe cleaning to reduce infection risks.
concepts.source: presentation slides 75–77; facilitator-guide PDF 30 demonstration b

concepts.statement_en: Distinguish mosquito exposure from respiratory and sharps-related transmission when choosing controls.
Demonstrate safe work and report gaps so hazards can be corrected, not merely named.
concepts.source: presentation slides 76–77; facilitator-guide PDF 30 outcomes b–c
